conflicts_resolved: 1. Test style: stdlib testing + go-cmp is the default for new code; testify is a tolerated incumbent (require over assert, testifylint on), never introduced.

2. Gate of record: golangci-lint v2, pinned. Every MUST names the underlying analyzer, so a go vet + staticcheck repo meets the same rules. 'No golangci config' is never a finding; noise linters never back a MUST; a MUST needs <=1 FP/10k LOC on >=5 exemplars.
3. Formatter: gofmt output is the MUST, goimports the SHOULD, gofumpt opt-in (gofmt 15/23, gofumpt 8/23, gci 5/23).
4. Functional options vs config structs: a decision procedure (positional, config struct, func-typed or interface-typed options; options return errors when they can conflict), not a winner.
5. Accept interfaces, return concrete types; consumer-side interfaces by default, producer-side only for a real subsystem abstraction.
6. Layout: go.dev/doc/modules/layout, never a new pkg/, internal/ mandatory for the SDK.
7. Sentinels for conditions, typed errors for data; %w only for what the doc comment promises, %v deliberately at boundaries.
8. Panics only for programmer errors and violated invariants; never os.Exit or log.Fatal outside package main.
9. slog vs zap: both audits right on different metrics (slog leads by repo breadth 11/34 vs 6; zap by files); slog is the SHOULD for new code.
10. One go-quality rule (index + support directory, **/*.go) plus go-modules for a different glob; rust-quality is not the template.
11. Tool configs (.golangci, goreleaser, .ko.yaml, staticcheck.conf) and go.work join go-modules with widened globs, because the frame's names would miss 11 of 13 goreleaser configs.
12. go/toolchain directives: libraries declare a floor, applications the release they build with; toolchain is a minority practice (5/35), not a default.
13. t.Context() and testing/synctest are defaults, gated by the module's go line (1.24 / 1.25).
14. encoding/json/v2 is default-on in 1.27.1 (buildcfg JSONv2: true; opt-out GOEXPERIMENT=nojsonv2); whether v1 behaviour changed is a P0 fixture in wave 3.

15. Era rows overturned: WaitGroup.Go and synctest GA are 1.25; the vet waitgroup analyzer is distinct from the waitgroupgo fixer; the time.After leak was fixed in 1.23; SA5011 disabled and SA9010 added in staticcheck 2026.2; golang/mock archived.
16. SIGPIPE: Go never panics but by default dies by signal (status 141), not the pinned exit 0; the CLI-05 contract stands and wave 2 pins the Go mechanism.
17. H8: consuming and shipping releases are different problems; goreleaser in 12/35, full signs+sboms+checksum in 3; the fleet mirror consumes raw binaries verified by github_asset_digest.
18. golangci config census is 23/35 (a depth-2 search missed etcd tools/.golangci.yaml and k8s hack/golangci.yaml).
